messages:
Sam: Cutting RC candidate now: `redwood-rc-2026-04-02-3` (artifact: `redwood-inference:v2026.04.02-3`). Requesting quick sign-off and pin for promo in the 22:00 UTC change window.
Sam: Release notes draft here: https://confluence.redwood/inference/rcs/redwood-rc-2026-04-02-3 (short summary + breaking flags).
deploy-bot: build created: https://ci.redwood/builds/8483927, artifact sha256: `3f2a9b7d...`. Staging image pushed to `staging-inference:rc-2026-04-02-3`.
Olivia: I can sign off on infra changes. Are we pinning runtime `libserving` to `v1.12.0` as well?
Sam: yes, pin `libserving=v1.12.0` and `onnx-runner=2.4.1` in the deployment manifest.
Matt: smoke tests queued, will run canary at 10% traffic for 15 minutes. Can we set rollback triggers: 1) 5min error rate > 1% 2) p50 latency > 2x baseline or p99 > 5x baseline 3) quality regression on eval set > 3%?
Joyce: agree on metrics. Add automatic fallback policy to route to `redwood-rc-2026-03-28-2` on trigger.
Sam: noted. I'll add the fallback rule to the rollout config.
deploy-bot: smoke tests passed (9/9). Canary started at 10% to staging route. Canary analysis: error_rate=0.02%, p50=42ms, p99=180ms — within thresholds.
Olivia: quick check — any infra conflicts with other promos in the same window? I see a DB migration scheduled in prod at 22:30 UTC for another service.
Sam: good catch. We can promote earlier in the window at 22:00 UTC and finish before 22:25 to avoid overlap.
lisa-sheriff: +1. Need a 30-minute runway for monitoring after promo. Recommend start at 22:00 and hold on cross-team DB migration until we confirm stability.
Matt: remote artifact pin request submitted: `pin artifact redwood-inference:v2026.04.02-3` -> ops approved.
Joyce: add note to release notes about fallback behavior and user-facing changelog: short mention of improved batching and a minor tokenizer fix.
Sam: rolling plan: 22:00 UTC start, canary 10% x 15m, ramp to 50% x 10m, ramp to 100% x 10m, monitor guards. If any guard trips — run rollback command below.
Sam: ```
# rollback to previous stable
kubectl set image deploy/inference-service inference-container=redwood-inference:v2026.03.28-2 --namespace=prod
# or trigger route fallback
redwoodctl rollout set-fallback --service inference --to redwood-rc-2026-03-28-2
```
deploy-bot: promotion scheduled at 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z by Sam. Lock acquired for `inference-service` from 22:00-22:40 UTC.
Olivia: I sign off on infra and rollback procedures. :thumbsup:
Matt: I sign off on runtime and metrics.
Joyce: I sign off on QA and release notes.
lisa-sheriff: Sheriff sign-off given. I will be on-call for the window + 30m.
Sam: thanks everyone — pin done, rollout config committed, release notes published. I'll trigger the deploy at 22:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: NOTE: if rollback is executed, open incident with template `rc-rollback-template` to capture postmortem data.
Sam: final: promote on schedule. Posting final checklist in the channel 15m before start. :rocket:
